subject: Storwell: multi-project activation request & term alignment
messages:
From: Amit Rao <amit@storwell.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Martinez <elena@storwell.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Expansion request — enable three new project namespaces + capacity uplift

Hi Jonas,

Hope you had a great weekend. Quick ask from our product org: we want to activate three new project namespaces under our existing account (customer-facing chat, internal analytics, and billing-automation). Primary requests:
- Issue separate API keys scoped per project (key rotation to remain account-level)
- Staggered rollout over 3 weeks (start Nov 1)
- Increase committed qps from 150 -> 300 for the month of November to support burst testing

We're also hoping to align the term on those new projects with our annual contract (current renewal due Feb 1). Can you send a short proposal and expected delta in monthly committed spend?

Attaching a short doc with proposed timeline and functional owners.

Thanks — Amit

Attachments: Storwell_Expansion_Req_2028-10-15.pdf (pdf stub, 120KB)

--
Amit Rao
Head of Platform
Storwell.ai
amit@storwell.ai
+1 415-555-0182

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amit Rao <amit@storwell.ai>
Cc: Elena Martinez <elena@storwell.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Oct 2028 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — enable three new project namespaces + capacity uplift

Thanks Amit — happy to help. High-level response and next steps below.

Quick answers:
- We can provision three distinct API keys scoped per-project as requested. Keys will be issued with project prefixes (e.g. storwell-chat, storwell-analytics, storwell-billing).
- Staggered rollout starting Nov 1 is fine; propose one project enabled per week (Nov 1, Nov 8, Nov 15) to allow monitoring and throttling adjustments.
- To support burst testing, we can increase committed qps to 300 for November; we estimate the committed spend delta at roughly $18k for the month (detail in attached addendum).

Requests from our side:
1) Confirm if keys should be read-only for analytics or full access.
2) Provide a primary security contact for the key rotation plan.
3) Please confirm which three projects map to which internal owners (so we can set RBAC and dashboard access).

I've attached a proposed addendum that aligns the three new project namespaces to your current contract and includes a short DocuSign-ready amendment. Ben and Laura are looped for pricing and SOW changes.

Next steps:
- You confirm items (1)-(3) above by EOD Wed, Oct 18
- We share finalized addendum and DocuSign link by Oct 20
- Key activation schedule triggered upon signed addendum

Best,
Jonas
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
+1 650-555-3420

Attachments: Storwell_Expansion_Proposed_Addendum_2028-10-15.pdf (pdf stub, 210KB), SOW_Storwell_Q4_v1.docx (docx stub, 85KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Amit Rao <amit@storwell.ai>, Elena Martinez <elena@storwell.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Oct 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — enable three new project namespaces + capacity uplift

Jonas / Laura — quick ops and pricing notes (looping in customer so they have visibility):
- Pricing: the incremental committed qps from 150 -> 300 for one month maps to the committed tier jump. The $18k estimate Jonas shared assumes standard token mix and our current rate card; if Storwell expects higher avg tokens per call we'll need to adjust.
- Billing/Prorate: we'll prorate the uplift to the activation date within November. If they prefer a flat one-month uplift we can bill Nov 1 - Nov 30.
- Keys and governance: Ops recommends issuing keys via our console with project-level tags and enabling prefix-based usage quotas. We'll add alerting thresholds at 70/85/95% of the uplifted qps to avoid surprises.
- Contract: small amendment (Appendix A) to add three project namespaces under the account and a one-month temporary capacity uplift. If they want long-term uplift we should convert to a reserved capacity SKU (quote separately).

Suggested language for addendum (for DocuSign):
"Redwood will provision three project namespaces under the existing customer account. Temporary uplift to 300 qps will be effective Nov 1 - Nov 30, 2028. Charges will be prorated to the activation date. The term for the three project namespaces will align with the existing account term ending Feb 1, 2029 unless otherwise agreed in writing."

I'll prepare the precise billing schedule once Amit confirms start dates.

Ben
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

--

Date: Wed, 17 Oct 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — enable three new project namespaces + capacity uplift

Thanks all — confirmation below so we can proceed.

1) Project mapping:
- storwell-chat -> Product (Elena Martinez) -> full access
- storwell-analytics -> Data (Ravi Shah, ravi@storwell.ai) -> read-only
- storwell-billing -> Finance (Meera Patel, meera@storwell.ai) -> full access

2) Security contact for rotation: Priya Natarajan (priya@storwell.ai)

3) Start dates: Nov 1 (chat), Nov 8 (analytics), Nov 15 (billing) — we accept prorated billing approach.

We reviewed the addendum and are good with the temporary uplift and term alignment to Feb 1, 2029. Please send the DocuSign link and SOW final version.

Thanks — Amit
